text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp starts today!
The Umamusume will undergo special training
at the Tracen Academy special facility!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Stepping off the bus,
I head toward the familiar entrance of the training camp lodge.
choice_data_list: Alright, let's give it our all again this year!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Wait, HEY!!??

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Why the hell are you at the training camp?!
You got injured in an accident, didn't you?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Even so, fortunately, my injury was minor enough
that I could still make it, so there is no problem.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Until a few days ago,
she had been hospitalized for several days...
Fortunately, it wasn't anything serious, and she was safely discharged.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: You really are something...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: —Idiot...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...So annoying...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Parting ways with her,
I hurried to my room to drop off my luggage.
There's no time to take it easy during summer training camp.
choice_data_list: (Summer is the season when Umamusume grow the most!)
(Summer is when Umamusume grow the most, after all!)

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Ah, excuse me!
The ingredients for the training camp just arrived,
so could someone give me a hand carrying them?!

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Wait, hey, hey!
What are you talking about?!

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text: —You have broken ribs, don't you!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —What happened the other day was a rear-end collision.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I woke up after the accident, the very first thing I felt
was pure joy that I had regained consciousness.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, she was discharged from the hospital.
Apparently, her injuries, including the bruises,
will take two to three months to fully heal.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fortune was on our side, and everything was "fine."
I was able to consult the doctor regarding how to proceed, too—
There shouldn't be any problem, but...

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text: ...I know you don't want to step away from coaching your trainee Umamusume at a time like this, but...

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Weren't you told to prioritize rest?
Stop carrying heavy luggage around!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Word of the accident spread throughout the workplace.
Because of that, even after being discharged,
I ended up causing worry across the board.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still, it won't interfere with coaching Espoir City.
So being able to attend the training camp is—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hey!?
What the hell happened to you?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...This is bad. While giving form instructions,
I seem to have unconsciously twisted my body in a bad way."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A deep breath is... impossible. It makes the pain worse.
I take shallow breaths repeatedly so as not to jar my body.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: You bastard...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"...Did you hear?
About Espoir City's Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, a fractured rib, right?
I've done that before, and it's pretty brutal...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Being a trainer is pretty tough work...
If they want to recover, it'd be better to just rest.

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
...I understand feeling like you can't, though.
Summer is a crucial time for the Umamusume in your charge.

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
"Messing up the gears just when things are
going on a roll, all because of oneself...
I wouldn't want to do that if I were in their shoes either."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Fools...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...I take tonight's dose of painkillers and slowly steady my breathing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There's no way I'm letting Espoir City out of my sight right now.
I can easily push through a little bit of strain.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, summer training camp with Espoir City began!
